signature.one_line: Fast receipt-driven story: rolling gradient numerals, chat bubbles over chest, italic-serif caption accents.
unique_devices: Slot-machine rolling numerals: a giant accent-to-accent gradient digit rolls one digit per frame (easing out, then counting down for the next item) under a small lead line, unit word beneath, fading into a dark shirt
Receipts over the speaker: animated second accent chat bubbles pop over the chest, then full-screen message threads / social-post screenshots with the key line highlighted (~30 % of runtime)

Chromatic-aberration hook title: giant white ordinal fading to transparent at the bottom with red/accent fringes, a sans line under it and the last word in italic serif, built line by line over b-roll
Small 2-3 word lowercase white sans captions with one italic display-serif accent word; captions move onto a grey pill over white screenshots
signature.why_it_works: Three specific numbers land in seconds, every story beat gets visual proof, and an even ~1.9 s two-scale cut rhythm keeps a dense voice moving.

hook.type: social proof / credential numbers + explicit open loop
hook.first_frame: Seated speaker in dark clothing against a saturated coloured wall, medium close-up; small white lead line at chest height with a giant accent gradient numeral rolling beneath it

structure.what: three counts shown as rolling numerals, two b-roll shots under a big chromatic title, explicit open loop
blur transition; name + role lower-third; speaker composited over a collage of thumbnails to show scale
conflict told through chat bubbles over the speaker, then full-screen message-thread screenshots
the turn: positive reply bubble, second call, concrete deal number, b-roll at desk
third-party social posts zoomed with highlighted lines

captions.what: 2-3 word lowercase white sans line with optional italic-serif accent word
captions.how: centred, centre y 60.5 % H on the chest; Inter 600 69 px; hard cut per phrase, -2 to +4 frames vs first word; scales with punch-ins (~1.15x); on white screenshots the same line sits on a grey pill

background_text.what: big chromatic title: ordinal + sans line + italic-serif last word
background_text.how: white ordinal Inter 600 192 px fading to transparent at the bottom, red/accent fringes ~3 px, centred x ~46 %, y 17-25 %; sans line Inter 500 82 px at y 27-30 %; builds line by line with a chromatic flicker
name Inter 700 69 px white on a square solid accent box x 28.5-70 %, y 72-76.5 %; role Inter 500 42 px at 78.6 % H; box wipes in from the left

motion_graphics.what: slot-machine rolling numerals for spoken counts
motion_graphics.how: lead line centred at 57 % H; digit Inter 600 310 px centred 59-71.5 % H, vertical gradient accent -> accent; rolls 1 digit/frame easing out (0->6 in ~11 frames), counts down for the next item; unit word at ~73 % H revealed syllable by syllable with 2-frame fades

motion_graphics.what: animated chat bubbles over the chest
motion_graphics.how: second accent rounded bubbles with small white text and a round avatar pop in over the chest; replies in white bubbles with a grey avatar

silhouettes_cutouts.what: speaker composited over a collage of thumbnails
silhouettes_cutouts.how: speaker cut out in front of a grid of thumbnails to visualise scale

broll_inserts.what: speaker working b-roll (video call, desk at night, phone)
broll_inserts.how: warmer and darker than the A-roll, carries big titles

broll_inserts.what: full-screen screenshot receipts with highlighted lines and slow screen zoom
broll_inserts.how: ~2 s each, key line highlighted, captions switch to grey pill

camera.how: locked-off seated MCU alternating with ~120 % CU punch-in every ~1.9 s

transitions.how: short defocus dissolve ~4-6 frames; audio leads the cut (J-cut) on ~40 % of cuts

case.caption: lowercase as spoken, capital only on 'I', proper nouns and sentence starts

captions_spec.punctuation: mostly none; a full stop survives at a sentence end, hyphens kept

grouping.sync: phrase-level: the 2-3 word line appears whole; within the hook a word can reveal syllable by syllable
grouping.break: hard cut to the next phrase

layout.hook_stack: lead line centred at 57 % H, giant numeral centred under it (59-71.5 % H), unit word centred under the numeral at ~73 % H, overlapping the numeral's faded bottom
layout.punch_in: captions scale with the punch-in (~1.15x) - the zoom is applied after the captions
layout.screenshots: on white screenshot sections the caption sits on a grey pill, same position (centre y 60.7 %)

caption.letterform_evidence: double-storey a, straight-tailed y, flat-ended s, compact grotesque widths, tight default spacing
caption.calibration_note: measured on the grey pill (clean); a 3-word lowercase phrase over a dark shirt measured 2.66 % H / 33.6 % W at the same size. The hook lead line is larger (3.67 % H, inside the punch-in).
caption.box: none on footage; on white screenshots a grey pill (rgba(60,60,62,.6) estimated), x 32.5-67.5 %, y 58-63 %, radius ~15 px @1080 (estimated)

closest_match.google: Instrument Serif Italic / Playfair Display Italic

accent_serif.letterform_evidence: italic, high stroke contrast, ball-less sharp terminals, narrow italic k and o
accent_serif.calibration_note: on plain wall b-roll (clean height; width not isolated). fit_font renders UPRIGHT Playfair: use the ITALIC at the same px and check the height only. Inside a sans line the italic word is set at the same cap height as the sans.
accent_serif.used_for: one accent word per line (a verb or the noun that carries the story)

numeral.calibration_note: single digit in the punched-in shot; blue-dominant pixels; the gradient fades into the dark shirt at the bottom so the height is a lower bound (12.5-13.75 % H on other digits)
numeral.color: vertical gradient: bright blue #0259BA at the top -> navy #123153 at the bottom (fades into the dark shirt)
numeral.position: centred x 50 %, 59-71.5 % H, under the lead line

title_big.calibration_note: short ordinal measured at 7.4 % H (lower bound, fade-truncated), 29.6 % W; the original '1' has a long flag, so the word is much wider than Inter's at the fitted size; fitted on height only
title_big.color: #FFFFFF fading to transparent at the bottom; red/cyan chromatic-aberration fringes (~3 px @1080)
title_big.position: centred on x ~46 %, y 17-25 % over b-roll; later over the chest in the numeral gradient

title_line.calibration_note: one 13-letter lowercase word measured at 2.97 % H, 41.8 % W; the next word follows in the italic serif on its own line
title_line.position: centred under the big title, y 27.3-30.2 %

lower_third_name.calibration_note: two-word Title Case name measured at 2.81 % H, 38.1 % W, white on the blue box (clean)
lower_third_name.box: solid blue #0A4C8A rectangle (square corners), x 28.5-70 %, y 72.2-76.5 %, padding ~1.5 % W

lower_third_role.calibration_note: role + company line measured at 1.72 % H, 40.8 % W, white over a dark shirt (clean)
lower_third_role.position: centred under the name box, centre y 78.6 %

animation.caption_entry: hard cut, whole 2-3 word phrase in 1 frame; may land exactly on a shot cut; otherwise from ~2 frames before to ~4 frames after the first spoken word
animation.syllable_reveal: in the hook a word is revealed in parts, the new part fading in over ~2 frames (grey then white)
animation.numeral_roll: slot-machine counter: one digit per frame, easing out (0,0,1,2,3,4,4,5,5,5,5,6 over ~11 frames), counting down for the next item; numeral stays centred
animation.title_entry: big title builds line by line with a chromatic-aberration flicker (estimated)
animation.lower_third_entry: box wipes in from the left while the name slides in over ~12 frames (estimated), holds ~85 frames

big white ordinal with a fade-out bottom and chromatic fringes, a sans line, last word in italic serif ('Headline here'); over b-roll at 17-30 % H, later over the chest in the numeral gradient

use_when: A first-person story with concrete numbers (counts, attempts, money) that can be shown as rolling numerals
The speaker has receipts: messages, emails, posts or reviews that can be screenshotted
A seated talking-head with fast, dense delivery that needs an even cut rhythm
The goal is a comment-keyword lead magnet at the end
avoid_when: No screenshots or proof material are available (the format depends on receipts)
Calm, reflective or emotional delivery that needs long holds
Busy or light backgrounds behind the chest where small white captions lose contrast
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B09 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B09.json) to this brand.
Canvas 1080x1920, 25 fps. Seated speaker, plain saturated wall, dark top.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{TEXT}} >= 4.5:1 on the chest/shirt, numeral gradient top {{ACCENT}} must stay >= 3:1 on the footage and darken toward the shirt)
- {{TEXT}}: default #FFFFFF (captions, titles)
- {{ACCENT}}: default #0259BA (numeral gradient top; bottom = a 60 % darker shade, default #123153)
- {{ACCENT_2}}: default #7500FE (chat bubbles)
- {{SURFACE}}: default rgba(60,60,62,.6) grey pill behind captions on white screenshots
- {{CARD_BG}}: default #0A4C8A (square lower-third name box)
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}}: default Playfair Display italic (Instrument Serif Italic preferred) for accent words
- {{FONT_BODY}}: default Inter 600 (captions, numerals, titles)
- {{HANDLE}}: default @handle (chat bubble sender, screenshots)
- {{LOGO}}: not used on screen

CAPTIONS
1. Latin, as spoken, lowercase except 'I', proper nouns and sentence starts; keep hyphens; at most a full stop at a sentence end; no emoji.
2. One line of 2-3 words per phrase.
3. {{FONT_BODY}} at 69 px, {{TEXT}}, tracking -0.01em, very soft shadow 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35), no stroke, no box. Centred, centre y 60.5 % H.
4. At most one accent word per line in {{FONT_DISPLAY}}, same cap height as the sans inline; standalone accent words over b-roll at 137 px, left-aligned at x 17 %, y 22-30 %.
5. Over white screenshots: same caption on a {{SURFACE}} pill (radius ~15 px, padding ~3 % W) at 60.7 % H.
6. Hard cut per phrase, from 2 frames before to 4 frames after the first word, or exactly on a shot cut; captions are applied before punch-ins so they scale ~1.15x with the shot.

NUMBERS (hook)
7. When the hook states counts: lead line centred at 57 % H; giant numeral in {{FONT_BODY}} 310 px centred at 59-71.5 % H with a vertical gradient {{ACCENT}} -> dark shade fading into the shirt; unit word in {{TEXT}} at ~73 % H revealed syllable by syllable with 2-frame fades. Roll like a slot counter: one digit per frame easing out (0 -> N over ~11 frames), count down for the next item.

OTHER TEXT AND EDIT DEVICES
8. Hook title over b-roll (~8-9 % of runtime): big ordinal/number in {{FONT_BODY}} 192 px, {{TEXT}} fading to transparent at the bottom, red/cyan chromatic fringes ~3 px, centred x ~46 %, y 17-25 %; a sans line in Inter 500 82 px at y 27-30 %; last word in {{FONT_DISPLAY}}; builds line by line with a chromatic flicker.
9. Lower-third after the hook (12-18 % of runtime, ~85 frames): 'Name Surname' Inter 700 69 px {{TEXT}} on a square {{CARD_BG}} box (x 28.5-70 %, y 72-76.5 %), 'Role, Company' Inter 500 42 px at 78.6 % H; box wipes in from the left.
10. Receipts: {{ACCENT_2}} rounded chat bubbles with small white text and a round avatar pop in over the chest; replies in white bubbles; then full-screen screenshots (~2 s each, slow zoom, key line highlighted) for ~30 % of runtime. Blur private names.
11. Cut rhythm: every ~1.9 s alternate locked-off MCU and a ~120 % CU punch-in; ~half the transitions are short blur/defocus soft cuts; let audio lead ~40 % of cuts (J-cut).
12. Optional: speaker cut-out composited over a thumbnail collage when scale is mentioned. No end card, no emoji.

GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: punchy contrast, cool saturated backdrop, warm natural skin, b-roll warmer and darker.
SOUND: voice-led, compressed, -14 LUFS; whoosh/hit on about half the hard cuts; tick per numeral digit; soft pop per chat bubble.

VERIFY
a) Render the caption "exclusively" on the grey pill at 60.7 % H and measure:
   python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test_render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.2,0.57,0.8,0.64 --ink "{{TEXT}}:60"   (default ink #FFFFFF)
   Required: 3.28 % ±0.5 of H, 31.4 % ±2 of W.
b) Numeral "4" at 310 px: --box 0.35,0.55,0.65,0.75 --ink "{{ACCENT}}:90" -> ~11-12.5 % H, 18.8 % ±2 W.
c) Accent "to close" in the italic at 137 px: height 5.7 % ±0.5 H (height only).
d) Lower-third: render "KEY WORD" in Inter 700 69 px on the box, --box 0.29,0.73,0.69,0.77; expected ink for the brand's real name: video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "Inter 700" --word <name>.
e) If {{FONT_BODY}} is not Inter 600, re-solve with fit_font.py --font "{{FONT_BODY}}" --word exclusively --ink 3.28 --width 31.4.
